adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes the Disqus Thor CLI `--category` option (deleted `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'`) and also replaces the `PostCreator.new(... created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), category: category_id)` call with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which does not pass `created_at` or any category. As a result, existing `disqus:import` invocations using `-c/--category` will fail option parsing, and imported topics/posts will no longer preserve the original `created_at` from the Disqus thread data.
